mapper.select: select id, event_id, case_id, member_id, event_type, state_version, correlation_ref, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, created_at from ai_service_case_outbox where (status = 'PENDING' and (available_at is null or available_at <= now())) or (status = 'PUBLISHING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= now()) order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_service_case_outbox set status = 'PUBLISHING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and ( (status = 'PENDING' and (available_at is null or available_at <= now())) or (status = 'PUBLISHING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= now()) )
update ai_service_case_outbox set status = 'PUBLISHED', lease_until = null, published_at = now(), last_error = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING'

update ai_service_case_outbox set status = #{status},
available_at = null, available_at = date_add(now(), interval #{retryDelaySeconds} second),
lease_until = null, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING'
